title: Analysis: Two Years After Oct 7, Hezbollah Weakened as Israel Holds Southern Lebanon
detail: An Al Jazeera analysis published Oct 9 says Israel occupies parts of southern Lebanon up to about 10 km from the border, with over 1.2 million displaced and the World Bank estimating the economy contracted by more than 6% in 2026. It describes a Hezbollah facing a legitimacy crisis while the Lebanese state pursues its disarmament under a framework with Israel, over the group's objections. This is analysis rather than a new incident; no major new military event on Oct 3-9 could be independently confirmed.
